description: This file contains the implementation of the BankingService interface, providing CRUD operations for customers and accounts, as well as monetary transactions such as deposit, withdrawal, and transfer. It interacts with various repositories and leverages helper functions for entity conversions.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing banking operations such as managing customers, accounts, and transactions, annotated as a Spring @Service with required constructors.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database from given customer details.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches a list of all customers.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details identified by customer ID.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer record by ID.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account linked to a customer, optionally associating bank info.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account information by account ID.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates details of an existing account.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into an account, recording the transaction.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount from an account, recording the transaction, with balance check.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers an amount between two accounts, ensuring currency match and sufficient funds, recording two transactions.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Returns a list of transactions for a specific account.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Fetches the current balance of an account.

methods.name: getBalancesForCustomer
methods.description: Returns balances of all accounts linked to a specific customer.
